concept.title: Workspaces
concept.shortdesc: A workspace is one family tree: its people, families, events, sources and notes.

conbody.p: A workspace is one family tree. You can keep more than one. For example, one for the Brontë family and one for your own.

ul.li: People, such as Patrick Brontë and Maria Branwell.
Events, such as a birth or a marriage, with a date and a place.
Sources, which say where each fact came from.
